::: {.content-visible when-profile="id"}
Penilaian Programming Quiz terpisah dari Tugas - dilaksanakan tiga kali (Kuis 1, 2, 3) di laboratorium komputer menggunakan Safe Exam Browser, bukan dikumpulkan dari rumah seperti Individual Assignment. Lihat [halaman Jadwal](../index.qmd#jadwal-semester) untuk tanggal lengkap tiap kuis.

::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
Programming Quiz assessment is separate from Assignments - held three times (Quiz 1, 2, 3) in the computer lab using Safe Exam Browser, rather than submitted from home like Individual Assignments. See the [Schedule page](../index.qmd#semester-schedule) for the exact date of each quiz.
